messages:
zara: Heads-up: deploy-bot paused the promote for release v3.1.0 during the change window. Reason: artifact checksum mismatch on registry fetch + cache validation failed. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/100112 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=artifact_checksum_mismatch, artifact=backend@sha256:ff11ee22, fetched_checksum=sha256:ff11ee23, expected_checksum=sha256:ff11ee22, auto_retries=1
zara: snippet from the artifact-stage logs:
```
ERROR registry: blob fetch checksum mismatch for blobs/ff11ee22
WARN cache-validator: cache index returned stale entry for artifacts/backend/sha256:ff11ee22
```
liam: sounds like a race between artifact owner pushing and registry GC or mirror TTL. Mirror region sometimes serves a stale object while origin GC rewrote content.
release-coordinator: Change window ends in 25m. If we wait for registry reconciliation it's unpredictable. Options: 1) manual pin to last-good, 2) force re-upload and rerun CI (takes 45-60m), 3) short hold and auto-retry (10m).
devops-lead: Risk matrix: manual pin minimizes risk to window but requires callout in notes and follow-up to ensure the bad artifact isn't promoted later. Re-upload/rerun is safer for correctness but will likely miss the window.
nina: last-good backend artifact is backend@sha256:bb00dd99 promoted to stable 3h ago. No reported regressions. I'm +1 pin to avoid missing the window.
liam: if we pin, create a ticket to audit the registry write path and mirror TTL; also add a CI gate that rejects checksum mismatches earlier with clearer signal.
zara: agree. I'll create a follow-up: RST-718 "Investigate artifact checksum mismatch during promote; add diagnostics" and assign infra.
devops-lead: Approval received. Running promote command: `deployctl promote --artifact backend@sha256:bb00dd99 --target=stable --reason "checksum mismatch; avoid missing change window" --note "manual pin; follow-up RST-718"`
deploy-bot: Promotion executed by devops-lead. stable -> backend@sha256:bb00dd99. Release notes draft updated with: "Pinned backend to previous artifact due to transient registry checksum mismatch; follow-up investigation opened."
release-coordinator: Window unblocked. Action items: (1) rerun the original build CI after window, (2) if rerun passes and artifact checks, decide on re-promote, (3) otherwise prepare a hotfix.
liam: created RST-718 and linked CI logs. Also added a quick check to the registry operator playbook.
zara: Thanks all. Closing thread — will follow up with outcome of rerun. :sparkles:
